lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What was Steve wearing when you, you first got to his house?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: A white shirt and red shorts.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. You told us before that Jodi called a couple times, right?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What were you doing when Jodi called?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Sittin’ on the couch watching TV.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Was that before of after you had sex with Teresa?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Was Teresa still alive when Jodi called?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: No. (Brendan shakes head “no”) So Jodi calls, you had already killed Teresa? Is that correct?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Do you remember what time Jodi called about?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Why did you guys cut her hair?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did Steve ever say why he wanted you to do that?
